# Capability routing

## Plan depth is not capability routing

Select capabilities by the current unresolved need, not by a compulsory planning
stage or coding taxonomy. DIRECT may need no tools; GROUNDED needs bounded context;
INVESTIGATIVE may need hypothesis testing. Independently choose EPHEMERAL or
CHECKPOINTED persistence. Only the latter needs LITE/STANDARD/DEEP plan density;
record material density changes in an existing plan. This creates no second router.

description: Anti-slop frontend skill for landing pages, portfolios, and redesigns. The agent reads the brief, infers the right design direction, and ships interfaces that do not look templated. Real design systems when applicable, audit-first on redesigns, strict pre-flight check.
---

# tasteskill: Anti-Slop Frontend Skill

> Landing pages, portfolios, and redesigns. Not dashboards, not data tables, not multi-step product UI.
> Every rule below is **contextual**. None of it fires automatically. First read the brief, then pull only what fits.

---

## 0. BRIEF INFERENCE (Read the Room Before Anything Else)

Before touching code or tweaking dials, **infer what the user actually wants**. Most LLM design output is bad because the model jumps to a default aesthetic instead of reading the room.

### 0.A Read these signals first
1. **Page kind** - landing (SaaS / consumer / agency / event), portfolio (dev / designer / creative studio), redesign (preserve vs overhaul), editorial / blog.
2. **Vibe words** the user used - "minimalist", "calm", "Linear-style", "Awwwards", "brutalist", "premium consumer", "Apple-y", "playful", "serious B2B", 
[output compacted; full raw record retained locally]
g design-system MASTER.md and page overrides before generating or
persisting output. Verify and reconcile recommendations first. Never overwrite
accepted design tokens or files merely to reconcile the two skills; record one
agreed design direction in the project's existing design documentation.

resulting_evidence:
Usulan utama: **satu judul utama, satu CTA dominan, dan proyek sebagai bukti sebelum ajakan kontak.** Arah desain tetap warm monochrome dengan HTML/CSS yang ada.

Audit berdasarkan [landing.html](C:/Users/Lenovo/.andino/backups/required-routing-20261008/fixtures-codex/redesign/landing.html:1); belum mencakup tampilan browser. Source tidak menyertakan CSS, sehingga dominasi visual dinilai dari struktur elemen.

| Temuan | Perubahan konkret |
|---|---|
| `Portfolio` dan `Latest projects` sama-sama `h1`, sehingga hierarkinya setara. | Pertahankan satu `h1` untuk identitas/nilai utama. Jadikan `Latest projects` sebagai `h2` pada bagian proyek di bawah hero. |
| Contact dan Subscribe bersebelahan tanpa pembeda prioritas. | Dengan asumsi tujuan utama adalah pertanyaan proyek, jadikan **Contact** tombol utama berwarna arang. Pindahkan Subscribe ke bagian bawah sebagai tautan sekunder. |
| `#newsletter` tidak memiliki elemen tujuan. | Hilangkan Subscribe dari rancangan awal sampai tujuan newsletter tersedia; jangan tampilkan tautan buntu. |
| Bagian kontak hanya berisi “Email us”. | Tambahkan judul kontak dan tautan email yang benar-benar dapat digunakan setelah alamatnya tersedia. |
| Judul proyek belum diikuti konten proyek. | Tampilkan proyek nyata sebelum bagian kontak; jangan menambahkan contoh atau klaim fiktif. |

Susunan yang diusulkan: **hero → proyek terbaru → kontak → newsletter jika tersedia**. Hero memuat judul, satu kalimat penjelas, CTA Contact, serta tautan ringan “View projects” menuju bagian proyek.

Untuk hierarki visual, gunakan latar krem hangat `#F5F2EB`, teks arang `#292621`, judul utama sekitar 48–64 px di desktop/32–40 px di mobile, judul bagian 28–32 px, dan teks isi 16–18 px. Beri jarak antarbagian 64–96 px; CTA utama cukup satu gaya solid, dengan area sentuh minimal 44 px dan fokus keyboard yang jelas.
